images.name: CARE-ASE
observed_modules: tri-modal short-axis inputs with availability vector
global-step training schedule and safety contract
observed_dataflows: LGE/T2/C0 inputs feed shared stock trunk
top decoder features branch into three high-resolution paths
soft anatomy context is detached before pathology branches
scar path uses LGE evidence plus weak C0/support and soft context
edema path uses T2 evidence plus weak LGE/C0/support and soft context
final logits combine anatomy, pure-edema, and scar logits with T2-present/T2-absent class competition
observed_safety_rules: detach/stop-gradient from context to pathology branches

images.name: SRR-v3
observed_dataflows: observed modalities enter modality-specific stems and shared encoder
availability plus pooled features route retrieval dictionaries
routed anatomy/scar/edema features feed proposal decoders
anatomy prior/distance/uncertainty gates guide lesion proposal
scar and edema proposals feed separate soft-ROI refiners
final output is nnU-Net baseline plus bounded residual corrections
cine frames use ED anchor, registration/warping, temporal retrieval, and aggregation
observed_safety_rules: no zero-filling; only observed modalities used
closed gate gives exact nnU-Net fallback
soft ROI rather than hard ROI

images.name: MoSAIC
observed_modules: multi-scale fusion decoder with attention gating
observed_dataflows: LGE/C0/T2 plus availability and supervision vectors feed MyoPS branches
CoarseNet produces myocardium/LV/RV anatomy priors
FinePathNet uses LGE/C0/T2 encoders and TPS alignment for scar authority
edema expert uses cardiac mask and modality features to generate edema zone
fusion decoder combines multi-scale skip features with learned gates
scar overrides edema during label fusion
cine branch uses ED-anchored selected frames, anatomy prior, shared encoder, motion decoder, and pathology head
observed_safety_rules: missing annotation has zero loss gradient
scar is authoritative over edema in final fusion
inference constraints include class-specific thresholds, small-component removal, largest edema-zone component, and largest scar component
default cine pathology head does not use raw cine intensity
explicitly_absent_components: raw cine intensity in default pathology head

caveat: Independent visual-smoke observation from attached images only; not a scheduled GPT task and not sufficient to arm care-ase-faithful.
